col_CO.note: derived: the 'NO. OF SHARES APPLIED FOR' column of the BASIS OF ALLOCATION tables (pages 9-10) gives the PER-APPLICATION tier amount, not a tier total (row '500 / 6,679 / 3,340 out of 6,679 to receive 500 Shares / 50.01%': 500 Shares per application, 3,340/6,679 = 50.01% = application success rate). Total shares applied for = SUM(tier size x NO. OF VALID APPLICATIONS) = Pool A 26,609,500 + Pool B 15,450,000 = 42,059,500. Checks: (a) that equals 6.2775 times the 6,700,000 final Hong Kong Offer Shares, matching the disclosed 'Subscription level 6.28 times' (page 4); (b) the same tier table's allotments sum to 3,350,000 (Pool A) + 3,350,000 (Pool B) = 6,700,000 = the final Hong Kong Offer Shares, so the tier table is complete and internally consistent; (c) summing the tier amounts alone (52,093,400) reproduces neither.
